name: SACRED-Bench
description:
SACRED-Bench
	

This repository hosts SACRED-Bench (Speech-Audio Composition for RED-teaming), a benchmark designed to evaluate the robustness of Multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) against complex audio-based attacks.
SACRED-Bench is introduced in the paper Speech-Audio Compositional Attacks on Multimodal LLMs and Their Mitigation with SALMONN-Guard.

reputation: Recently introduced benchmark used in research on audio-based adversarial attacks against multimodal LLMs; limited adoption outside specialized robustness/safety research so far.
